coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental units in properties in foreclosure or acquired through foreclosure (one or more rental units). Month-to-month tenants and owner-occupied two- and three-family units are not exempt from the 90-day notice requirement.
coverage.other_conditions: Triggered by a foreclosure. Some duties fall on the foreclosing creditor before title transfers; others fall on the person acquiring the foreclosed property after the sale.

result.notes: Changed other_conditions. The old text said 'only by foreclosure and transfer of title', but the guide also imposes pre-transfer notice duties on foreclosing creditors. Removed the sentence that posting replaces individual notices in buildings with more than 10 units: it describes landlord notice conduct, not coverage. Set requires_unknown_facts to true because the rule applies only to properties in or after foreclosure, a status assessor data cannot identify (event-only rule). Set min_units to 1 from the 'one or more residential rental units' language. There is no owner-occupied exemption: owner-occupied two- and three-family units are expressly not exempt from the 90-day notice. The federal non-preemption sentence concerns federal law, not this state rule, so the preemption fields stay null.
